title: Anthropic's Claude Fable Had Secret Guardrails Nobody Knew About
description:
Anthropic just apologized for operating Claude Fable with invisible safety restrictions. Developers had no clue their model was silently filtering outputs. Transparency in AI? Still a work in progress.
